decision.title: Product Launch Readiness
decision.summary: Publish a launch only when a new visitor can reproduce the promised first result, inspect the release, and find a clear boundary around what has not been tested.

claims.text: A release page makes a versioned change set and its target commit inspectable.

evidence.excerpt: A release page makes a versioned change set and its target commit inspectable.

contradictions.note: The installation or demo path could fail on a clean machine.

nextValidation: Run the deterministic demo on a clean machine, open the published release and site, then ask three target operators which artifact they inspected first and what they still could not verify.
limitations: This is a deterministic fixture; it is not fresh web research.
Hashes prove artifact integrity, not the truth, completeness, authorization, or freshness of a source.

integrity.note: The manifest covers exported files; receipt structure and evidence references are validated separately.
